title: Google Groups Management & Governance (Types, Lifecycle, Membership & Security)
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (enterprise Google Workspace administration/governance/compliance).

Google Admin console / Cloud Identity authored at exact detail from Google public docs; version-/preview-dependent behavior flagged 'verify in your tenant', never invented. Regulatory/compliance INTERPRETATION (CMMC assessment outcomes, NIST 800-171 applicability, ITAR/DFARS determinations, C3PAO assessment scheduling) is deferred to the organization's compliance/legal/assessor — the solution provides the technical control mapping, configuration method, and evidence, not the certification determination. Automation is Python (Admin SDK / APIs). No client names. No secrets/keys in code.
hook: Get Google Groups under a real management and governance model
problem: Google Groups quietly control mail distribution, access, and collaboration — and left unmanaged they become a sprawl of stale, over-permissioned, externally-exposed groups. This solution establishes Groups management & governance: group types and naming, the lifecycle (request → approve → review → retire), membership and ownership models, dynamic groups, security groups, external-membership and posting policy, and access-settings hygiene — so Groups are intentional, least-exposed, and auditable.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the Groups model: types & naming, lifecycle, membership/ownership, dynamic vs security groups, external/posting policy, and access-settings governance.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Workspace tenant + super-admin, identity/HR source for membership, naming standard, stakeholders).

Implementation Guide — define types/naming + lifecycle, set membership/ownership and dynamic/security-group models, apply external-membership + posting + access-settings policy, and stand up review/retirement — pilot-first, each group/policy named.

5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or operations helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/health or control check, and a scope/config helper — authentic Google Workspace Admin SDK / API automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
Validation gates (naming/policy enforced, no stale/orphaned groups, external exposure scoped) plus Best Practices for keeping Groups governed as they grow.
short: Establish Google Groups management & governance — types/naming, lifecycle (request→approve→review→retire), membership/ownership, dynamic + security groups, external/posting policy, and access-settings hygiene — so Groups are intentional, least-exposed, and auditable. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
